summary: A KRFFS root on a disk on IDE, written and read through a page cache half the size of the data or less; the program is tests/stressprobe.c

cases.behavior: 33 MiB of files written through the page cache of a KRFFS root mounted from a disk on IDE, at most 16 MiB of which the cache holds, synced and read back, keep every byte

execution.privileges: root, which writes the root directory
execution.cleanup: it removes each file it has read back; the disk is the attempt's private copy

assertions.checks: each of the 132 files of 256 KiB opens, is written whole and is synced
each file opens again and reads back whole
every byte read back equals the pattern of its file and offset

native.reason: the page cache's window it tests exists only for a KRFFS root that rach2.fsdisk mounts from the boot disk; tests/native/probes.cases runs the probe on a KRFFS volume
